title: Maagizo ya Dawa / Prescription
key_sentences: Tumia dawa zote kama ulivyoelekezwa hata kama utajisikia vizuri kabla ya kumaliza.
Kunywa maji mengi, angalau lita mbili kwa siku.
Usinywe pombe wakati unatumia dawa hizi.
Rudi kliniki baada ya siku saba kwa uchunguzi zaidi.
Hifadhi dawa mahali pakavu na mbali na watoto.

list_items.text: – Kidonge 1 mara mbili kwa siku kwa siku 7, baada ya chakula.
– Vidonge 2 kila baada ya saa 8 inapohitajika kwa maumivu au homa.
– Changanya pakiti 1 katika lita 1 ya maji safi na unywe siku nzima.

furniture: Dawa hizi zinatolewa kwa agizo la daktari pekee.
Prescription-only medicines. Valid for 30 days from the date of issue.
notes: A5 page. Swahili prescription with English labels (title second half 'Prescription', 'Diagnosis', and the second footer line). The medicines are a TYPED list: each level-0 item starts with the typed number '1.', '2.', '3.' and each level-1 dosage line starts with a typed en dash '–' and is indented 16 px; markers are part of the text and kept. The large 'Rx' symbol above the list and the bold 'Utambuzi (Diagnosis):' line are body labels, not headings or sentences. The patient grid is a 3-row key/value table (two pairs per row, no header). Furniture: three centred letterhead lines and two footer lines.
